description: D-8: stop a destructive ServiceNow write before it reaches the server — deny an apply:true without a plan_token in plan mode, ask the user in apply mode. The PreToolUse matcher names only the destructive tools (and their v2 names); test/plugin-hook.test.js pins it to the hook. N-48: inject the active profile and write mode at session start (local config only), and hint how to narrow a truncated ServiceNow result.
